architectural_conclusions.airlock_responsibility_boundary: Airlock is an authorization boundary and consequence broker, NOT a code quality gate. It guarantees that no network escapes or unapproved provider mutations occur, and that any external mutation strictly matches an operator-signed ReviewedGitHubCreate profile. It does NOT evaluate whether code compiles, passes tests, or contains defects.
architectural_conclusions.enterprise_quality_boundary: An enterprise MUST place an independent, host-side quality gate between untrusted AI agents and operator consequence signing. The quality gate must verify cryptographic patch digests, run regression and withheld tests against immutable test hashes, enforce strict file scope, and prevent TOCTOU substitution before the operator signs the consequence profile.
architectural_conclusions.final_answer: YES. An enterprise CAN place a trusted correctness-and-approval boundary between an unreliable AI coding agent and a consequential external change. When an independent host-side quality gate enforces immutable tests and digest binding, and Actenon Airlock enforces container isolation and exact consequence dispatch, failed patches NEVER ship (0 mutations), while verified positive changes are published safely (exactly 1 mutation).
